function.arguments: {"finding": "The original analysis incorrectly excluded refunded orders from the denominator. The question asks for the fraction of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH who converted. 'Reached' implies all such customers, regardless of final status. The 'converted' variable is defined as 1 if checkout was completed, so refunded orders are still part of the population — they were reached and did not convert. Excluding them was a misinterpretation of the population.", "implication": "The denominator must include all NEW paid_search customers, including those with status 'refunded'. This changes the result from 0.224 to 0.212. The method must be revised to include all such customers in the denominator."}
function.name: note_finding
